selectionRationale: The v21 release promotes complete original catalogs that have independent structural and language review; the remaining pinned-union locales stay deferred until the same evidence exists.

Korean and European Portuguese are additional regional catalogs outside the pinned union, recorded explicitly so exact locale selection and independent review remain auditable.

Every promoted catalog covers the complete DEFAULT_STRINGS snapshot with preserved placeholders, locale-appropriate CLDR plural categories, and no untranslated English prose beyond independently allowlisted technical terms, units, keyboard names, abbreviations, or format templates.
